title: #057. Theme Park Group Itinerary (Time Windows)
subtitle: Schedule up to K friend groups from the park entrance to visit every attraction within its [earliest, latest] opening window using Big-M arrival linking.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { itineraries, totalCost }.
judge.m1: Field "itineraries" must be an array of group itineraries.
judge.m3: Itinerary {p0} must be an integer array of length at least 3 ([0, ..., 0]).
judge.m4: Itinerary {p0} must start and end at entrance 0.
judge.m5: Attraction index {p0} is out of valid range [1, {p1}].
judge.m6: Attraction {p0} is visited more than once.
judge.m7: Attraction {p0} earliest feasible start ({p1}) exceeds latest window ({p2}).
judge.m8: Itinerary {p0} returns to entrance at {p1}, exceeding park closing time ({p2}).
judge.m9: Attraction {p0} was not visited by any group.
judge.m10: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed walking travel time ({p1}).
judge.m11: Time-window feasible itineraries, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
